name: Tencent AI Studio (aistudio.tencent.ai)
description: Tencent Hy AI Studio — developer/professional Hunyuan assistant: chat with streaming, deep search, deep thought/reasoning, image/video/3D generation, code execution, file upload + doc QA, TTS/ASR, podcast, translation, AI agent roles. Under the Tencent Hunyuan umbrella (yuanbao.tencent.com is the consumer surface; already covered by capabilities/hunyuan).
author: ui2api capability package
siteVersion: SPA on aistudio.tencent.com; API routes /api/new-portal/* (5 JS bundles ~12.6 MB; hy-web main 7.6 MB); chat = POST /api/new-portal/chat/{chatId} with JSON stream; auth = iOA/QR scan cookie-based

transport.protocol: HTTP POST; responses parsed as per-chunk JSON objects (NOT standard SSE — no text/event-stream literal found); exact byte framing to verify on live capture

loginFlows: POST /api/oalogin — Tencent iOA (enterprise SSO) login initiation (QR code scan)
auth.note: Server sets session cookies on login (likely hy_user + hy_token, same umbrella as yuanbao.tencent.com — exact cookie names to verify on live capture). X-Token/X-ID/Space-Id headers are injected for miniprogram/openapi contexts only; the primary web path is pure cookie auth.

headers.X-Token: session token (URL param or localStorage weapp-token — miniprogram mode only)
headers.X-ID: user ID (URL param or localStorage weapp-uid — miniprogram mode only)
headers.note: OpenAPI paths (path.startsWith('/openapi')) also get 'Authorization: Bearer <X-Token>'; primary web path uses cookies only

transport.streaming: Per-chunk JSON decode: response body parsed via JSON.parse(e.data) yielding {type, content, code, msg}; type mapped to internal HYCSpeechType enum; exact wire framing (newline-delimited JSON? length-prefixed? custom separator?) to verify on live capture

capabilities.name: Chat stream
capabilities.description: Send a prompt on the composer; streamed answer via POST /api/new-portal/chat/{chatId} (JSON chunk parsing). VERIFIED LIVE 2026-09-19: proof round-trips PASS (13717, 12, 72 — 'Reply with ONLY the number') on headed real Chrome + injected snapshot.
capabilities.method: ui-path (trusted input + Enter, site's own send handler) — LIVE-VERIFIED 2026-09-19
capabilities.implementation: DOM path (what is live-verified): composer textarea.t-textarea__inner (placeholder 'Ask me anything', TDesign) → dom.type focus+insertText+Enter → answer streams into .agent-chat__bubble--ai .hyc-content-md (markdown body .hyc-common-markdown), completion marker 'Completed'. preComposeDelayMs 8000 (cold boot: sends typed before ~5-8s are silently dropped). Wire: POST https://aistudio.tencent.ai/api/new-portal/chat/{chatId}; body = {model, prompt, options, plugin, searchDeepMode, aiRoleClone, ...}; response = JSON chunks parsed by JSON.parse(e.data) with type field → HYCSpeechType mapping; generate/id endpoint needed to create chatId; conversation continue for multi-turn.

capabilities.name: Web search (deep search mode)
capabilities.description: Toggle deep-search mode for grounded answers; sets searchDeepMode=true on the chat request
capabilities.implementation: searchDeepMode + searchDeepModeParentIndex fields on chat request body. Stream speech types SEARCH_DEEP_MODE, SEARCH_DEEP_MODE_FIN, ai_search_pro, card carry search-grounded content. Config: POST /api/new-portal/config {key:'getAgentConfig'}. Toggle DOM unverified.

capabilities.name: Deep thought / reasoning
capabilities.description: Chain-of-Thought reasoning mode (DEEP_THOUGHT / DEEP_THINK / REASONER stream speech types)
capabilities.implementation: Stream speech types DEEP_THOUGHT (11 refs), DEEP_THINK (9 refs), REASONER (8 refs), THOUGHT_WITH_IMG (11 refs) carry reasoning blocks. Exact toggle/request field to verify on live capture.

capabilities.name: Conversation CRUD + history
capabilities.description: List/get/rename/delete conversations via /api/new-portal/ endpoints + generate/id + continue. CURRENT POSTURE (2026-09-19, honest): the History entry (div.layout-menu__menu-history) renders NO anchor list on this revision — a DOM conversation-list selector is unverified, so the runner returns ok:false with mechanism notes until a live History capture.
capabilities.method: in-page fetch (credentials: include) — endpoints VERIFIED in bundles; DOM/list path UNVERIFIED
capabilities.implementation: POST /api/new-portal/user/agent/conversation/v1/detail, /api/new-portal/chat/conversation/update, /api/new-portal/chat/conversation/history/del, /api/new-portal/chat/conversation/clear, /api/new-portal/chat/conversation/share, /api/new-portal/user/agent/conversation/continue. Response shapes to verify on a live History capture.

capabilities.name: Image generation (DIT / vision)
capabilities.description: Generate images via /api/vision_platform/generation (DIT model at dit.hunyuan.tencent.com); poll via query_task
capabilities.implementation: POST /api/vision_platform/generation, /api/vision_platform/query_task, /api/vision_platform/query_task_list, /api/vision_platform/taskHistoryDel. Config: POST /api/new-portal/config {key:'visionGeneration'}. Supports style/clarity/outpainting/elimination/watermark-removal/OCR endpoints. 3D model host: 3d-models.hunyuan.tencent.com; video host: aivideo.hunyuan.tencent.com.

capabilities.name: Code interpreter / sandbox
capabilities.description: Execute code in a sandbox (coder/runCode features; env to verify)
capabilities.method: in-page or composer mode — VERIFIED-FEATURE / LIVE-SHAPE-TO-VERIFY
capabilities.implementation: coder (36 refs in index), runCode (7 refs) present in bundles. Execution environment type, language support, and invocation API not yet captured. Candidate for deep-think/code hybrid mode.

capabilities.name: File upload + document QA
capabilities.description: Upload docs via COS tempCred → genUploadInfo; parse via /api/resource/fileParse; document analysis rides chat as DOC_CARD/DOC_DEEP_MODE speech types
capabilities.method: in-page COS upload (Tencent COS SDK) or composer attach UI
capabilities.implementation: POST /api/new-portal/tempCred → COS upload → POST /api/new-portal/chat/resource/genUploadInfo → POST /api/resource/fileParse. Supported: pdf/doc/docx/ppt/pptx/xls/xlsx/txt/csv/md/video (from speechContent parser). Stream types: DOC_CARD, DOC_DEEP_MODE, DOC_DEEP_READ_CARD, doc_percent, docDeepModeInfo.

capabilities.name: Speech synthesis (TTS) + ASR
capabilities.description: Text-to-speech via /api/new-portal/audio/synthesis; speech recognition via /api/new-portal/asr/ + asr.cloud.tencent.com
capabilities.method: in-page fetch (TTS); ASR may require WebSocket to asr.cloud.tencent.com
capabilities.implementation: POST /api/new-portal/audio/synthesis (TTS). ASR: POST /api/new-portal/asr/file/recognize + queryTask; history: asr/history/list, asr/history/del. Real-time ASR via WebSocket to asr.cloud.tencent.com (events: 'asr.started'). WebRecorder/WebAudioSpeechRecognizer window globals present.

capabilities.name: Podcast generation
capabilities.description: Generate podcast content: audioDeltaBase64 chunks + script timing; interact via /api/new-portal/podcast/*
capabilities.implementation: POST /api/new-portal/podcast/hint, /api/new-portal/podcast/relInfo, /api/new-portal/podcast/interact. Stream speech type PODCAST (10 refs). Podcast data includes audioDeltaBase64 (chunked base64 audio) and script.text for word-level timing. Configure show/podcast-related localStorage flags.

capabilities.name: In-chat translation
capabilities.description: Translate via translateModelList + sourceLang/targetLang fields on chat request
capabilities.implementation: Chat request body includes translateModelList, sourceLang, targetLang, sourceLangLabel, targetLangLabel. Translation model list sourced from GET /api/agent/model/list or /api/models. Exact picker DOM to verify on live capture.
